title: DroopOPF validation and study evidence
sharing: Curated summaries only; full private archives, network inputs and solver logs are not bundled. No upload or publication is performed by generation.

label_meanings.M: Capability milestone: what the library implements.
label_meanings.S: Study campaign: numerical qualification under a declared contract.
label_meanings.P: Development priority/workstream: broader goals that may remain open despite accepted studies.

acceptance: Native solver status, independent physical replay, operating limits, control policy and catalogue coverage are separate gates. A numerical failure is unresolved unless separate evidence establishes a necessary exclusion under that exact contract.

records.title: AC OPF with fixed volt-var curves
records.meaning: Solve base AC dispatch with supplied reactive-response curves.
records.scope: Balanced steady-state AC cases with attached generator volt-var controls and fixed equipment.
records.method: Compare smooth and exact response encodings, reconstruct the exact curve and independently replay bus balances and operating limits.

findings.result: Base AC OPF, MATPOWER adapter, exact/smooth saturated volt-var response.
Independent equilibrium replay and deliberate-corruption tests.
Implementation and small-case numerical validation; not a large-network study.

records.boundary: No dynamic, global-optimality or arbitrary-network convergence claim.

records.title: Security-constrained AC OPF
records.meaning: Couple base and outage equilibria with an explicit active-response policy.
records.scope: Base dispatch plus declared branch/generator outages; preventive and corrective steady-state policies.
records.method: Check empty-catalogue equivalence, unavailable devices, response coupling, security-induced dispatch changes and independent scenario replay.

findings.result: Outage overlays preserve source input and deactivate failed equipment.
Base and outage dispatch share the declared response policy; not independent OPFs.
Empty contingency sets reproduce base OPF; invalid policies and perturbations are rejected.

records.boundary: Connected-catalogue acceptance is distinct from general island balancing or transient security.

records.title: Bounded droop design
records.meaning: Optimize declared droop parameters shared across training scenarios.
records.scope: Saturated volt-var slope, voltage reference and independently bounded lower/upper deadband widths.
records.method: Compare bounded optimization with a small sweep; fixed bounds reproduce SCOPF. Replay reconstructed exact curves and evaluate held-out scenarios.

findings.result: Shared bounded slope/reference/deadband parameters in the supported volt-var family.
Fixing selected parameters reproduces the underlying SCOPF problem.
Held-out checks have their own acceptance gate.

records.boundary: Arbitrary free-knot PWL topology, uniqueness and global optimality are outside this scope.

records.title: Robustness and benchmark gate
records.meaning: Measure repeated-start behavior, diagnostics and small public-case reproducibility.
records.scope: Named state/design starts, breakpoint distances, operating margins and pinned small public benchmark cases.
records.method: Retain all attempts and compare objective/parameter spread; separate solver, replay and policy failures; record actual model and resource measurements.

findings.result: Inputs, outputs, validation and objective/parameter spread are retained.
Near-breakpoint controls, binding limits and critical scenarios are identified.
Two pinned PGLib cases exercise adapter, solver, serialization and replay.

records.boundary: The original small-case gate does not establish large-system scaling or a universal solver ranking.

records.title: Transformer reference physics
records.meaning: Represent fixed transformer ratios, phase shifts, availability and terminal ratings.
records.scope: Fixed-ratio and fixed-phase AC transformer models, import/schema identity and OPF/SCOPF integration.
records.method: Compare the optimizer admittance primitive with independent internal-current reconstruction, analytical sweeps and outage/serialization checks.

findings.result: Both-terminal currents/powers, phase shifts, ratings and availability.
Fixed transformers participate in OPF, SCOPF and bounded droop design.
440/440 regression assertions at the M5 checkpoint; not a newly rerun count.

records.boundary: Tap optimization and automatic transformer AVR belong to later milestones.

slices.meaning: Phase shift, availability and terminal ratings

records.title: Shunt reference physics
records.meaning: Represent fixed shunts and supplied legal bank states.
records.scope: Bus conductance/susceptance, MATPOWER GS/BS and supplied capacitor/reactor bank counts.
records.method: Independently check signs, V-squared power accounting, legal fixed states, availability and study round trips.

findings.result: Positive conductance consumes active power; reactive power follows the declared susceptance sign and V-squared scaling.
Supplied immutable legal count states are modeled; this does not optimize switching.
691/691 regression assertions at the M6 checkpoint; not a newly rerun count.

records.boundary: Fixed heterogeneous banks are supported; general heterogeneous-bank optimization is separate.

records.title: Continuous equipment and joint droop optimization
records.meaning: Choose selected continuous taps, simple-bank susceptance and bounded droop parameters.
records.scope: Synthetic three-bus base operation; tap, shunt and droop freedom compared under the same dispatch-deviation objective.
records.method: Fixed-bound equivalence, independent current replay, tap/bank sweeps and an eight-configuration two-start joint-design comparison.

findings.check: M7.1 fixed / one tap / two taps
findings.result: AC residuals 2.43e-15 / 2.87e-13 / 5.83e-14 pu.
31-point capacitor/reactor sweeps and one/two-free-bank comparisons.
Eight fixed/free combinations, two starts each; all 16 reported starts physically valid.
AC 1e-6 pu; exact droop 1e-5 pu; continuous settings independently reconstructed.

Two starts each for Ipopt/MadNLP/CCOpt: 6/6 native and independent physical acceptances. Droop parameters fixed; this is an equipment-design comparison, separate from the historical joint grid. Recorded before the MadNLP 0.10.3 dependency update; its original environment is retained.

records.boundary: Continuous local solutions; no discrete implementability, security or large-system scaling claim. The objective is dispatch deviation, not loss.

records.title: Steady-state transformer AVR
records.meaning: Model an automatic transformer voltage-regulation equilibrium with limits.
records.scope: Transformer AVR targets/deadbands and limited ratio equilibrium, distinct from freely optimized ratios.
records.method: Validate the selected regulation mode, saturation behavior, unmet targets and physical reconstruction; preserve explicit control assignments.

findings.result: An AVR-controlled tap follows a regulation equilibrium rather than unconstrained loss optimization.
Saturation and unmet target conditions remain visible.
Static equilibrium does not infer delay, dwell, hunting, reached position or action count.

records.boundary: Transformer AVR is distinct from the generator AVR added to later mixed-control studies; dynamic/discrete control qualification is separate.

records.title: Equipment-aware SCOPF
records.meaning: Coordinate preventive equipment, automatic response and bounded corrective recourse.
records.scope: Shared preventive controls, scenario-specific corrective continuous controls and explicit timing/movement assumptions.
records.method: Check policy sharing, immediate/settled stages and bounded movement against independent scenario replay; zero movement reproduces the preventive policy.

findings.result: Selected common settings are shared over declared scenarios.
Only selected equipment can move, within absolute and movement bounds.
Immediate and settled states are paired static assessments, not a transient trajectory.

records.boundary: Any campaign must state actual devices, information sharing, movement budgets and assumed timing; no unlimited corrective adjustment is implied.

slices.meaning: Equipment policy layer and preventive sharing

records.title: Contingency assessment and comparative evidence
records.meaning: Assess catalogues, compare control modes and close bounded physics/reproducibility gates.
records.status: Declared scope complete; general qualification remains separate
records.scope: Assessment/ranking/screening workflows plus sourced equipment physics, matched synthetic comparisons and reproducibility/performance closeout.
records.method: Retain negative controls and failed attempts; distinguish equation-reference checks, matched comparisons and software regression from network security certification.

findings.result: 414 sourced equation-reference checks, three snapshots and eight applicable negative controls.
54 feasible comparison groups; fixed-Q 105% comparator has a certified negative result. Original all-feasible gate failed.
3,042/3,042 historical regression assertions, 126 saved-state replays and 32 profile runs.
Catalogues, exact evaluation, ranking and resumable campaigns are implemented.

records.boundary: Equation-reference transcription is not an external-solver benchmark; transformer AVR and broader public comparisons are outside the matched synthetic scope.

records.title: Convergence and scale study
records.meaning: Test base-operation droop/equipment optimization across control families and demand samples.
records.status: Historical declared scope closed; new deadband sensitivity separate
records.scope: ARPA-E 14/500-bus variants, Pmin=0, symmetric Q, zero deadband, continuous equipment, five demands 90/95/100/105/110% and OPF-derived starts.
records.method: Compare independent design-at-demand with one nominal design frozen across demands; keep primary scores, retries, native status and physical replay separate.

findings.result: 360/360 direct attempts; 120/120 solver/model/demand combinations accepted.
308/360 direct attempts; 120/120 combinations accepted after recovery.
14 buses: 48/48 direct; 500 buses: 42/48 direct and 48/48 after recovery.
0/0.005/0.01 pu half-width campaign is separate and in progress; historical closure is unchanged.

records.boundary: No original-Q-limit frozen-equipment, unseen-demand, dynamic or security closure follows. Known-witness performance is not an unseen-start success rate.

records.title: Shared security-design study
records.meaning: Design one controller across training demands/outages and test it on held-out demands.
records.status: 14-bus declared scope closed; original 500-bus campaign paused
records.scope: Historical Pmax-proportional response and explicit S2 equipment/operating contracts. Zero-deadband 14-bus shared design has five training and four held-out demands.
records.method: Require native design convergence, exact AC/controller replay, sharing/response policy checks and explicit catalogue coverage; retain separate emergency/relief lanes.

findings.result: Ipopt, MadNLP and CCOpt each qualify five training and four held-out demands over 24 connected outages.
675 connected-state records plus 27 conditional island projections; zero recorded discrepancies.
Original campaign paused; normal-limit, emergency/relief and later P2 results retain separate policies.
In progress under a separately declared normal-limit/full-load sensitivity; does not resume original S2.

records.boundary: No general islanding, continuous-demand, global-optimality or full 500-bus S2 closure. Later P2 success does not rewrite S2 history.

records.title: Proof-of-concept foundation
records.meaning: Establish the smallest executable model-to-independent-validation workflow.
records.scope: Package/CI, typed domain, MATPOWER import, base AC OPF, exact/smooth curves, one contingency and independent reports.
records.method: Exercise a complete small-case workflow and reject corrupted states rather than using solver status as the physical acceptance test.

findings.result: Package/CI, types, input validation and MATPOWER adapter.
AC OPF, independent residuals, exact/smooth curves and reactive sharing.
One contingency, independent equilibrium validation and reports/examples.

records.boundary: Foundation scope overlaps M1/M2 evidence; these are not independent repetitions to add to campaign totals.

records.title: Useful research-prototype workflow
records.meaning: Make studies repeatable, diagnosable and serializable.
records.scope: Multiple contingencies, preventive/corrective modes, smoothing continuation, exact replay, serialization, named starts, public regression and measurements.
records.method: Preserve inputs, every solver outcome, independent validation, objective/parameter spread and environment/model-resource measurements.

findings.result: Multiple outages, policy modes, epsilon continuation, exact/smooth replay and versioned serialization.
Named M2 state and M3 parameter starts retain outputs and spread.
Two pinned PGLib-OPF v23.07 cases exercise the full adapter/solve/replay path.
Environment, actual JuMP dimensions, timing, allocations, objective and validity recorded.

records.boundary: This is a workflow priority, not a distinct network benchmark or proof of universal numerical robustness.

records.title: Scaling and qualification
records.meaning: Improve larger security studies while retaining complete final AC qualification.
records.status: Broader P2 open; latest declared connected-catalogue design qualified
records.scope: Sparse models, ranking/filter diagnostics, bounded scenario addition, initialization, backends and fixed-candidate exhaustive assessment. Current mixed 500-bus lane uses limit-aware response. The selected joint model uses Ipopt.
records.method: Use bounded joint masters and full candidate scans; distinguish necessary exclusions from numerical failures. Reoptimize common controls for recovery, freeze the candidate, then replay all accepted results.

findings.result: joint-five; Ipopt; feasibility objective, five one-hour demands 90/100/105/100/90%.
389/389 accepted five-period outage trajectories; no remaining numerical failures in that catalogue.
390 selected result files and 3,910 replayed state instances including repeated bases.
Full load, normal voltage/Rate-A, limit-aware active response; 15 AVR / 36 droop and assumed S=Pmax/0.95 circles.
131 continuous taps, supplied ±5%, movement ≤0.025 supplied ratio; 11 continuous banks, legal envelopes and ≤two sections; assumed 120-second settled stage.
121.62343825 MWh over five hours; not a certified minimum.
General predictive skipping, full-catalogue resource/loss optimality, dynamics/discrete validation and large coupled memory limits.

records.boundary: All-connected-outage acceptance is not general islanding/transient security or overall P2 closure. Exact-S2 proportional filters cannot be applied to production limit-aware response. Equivalent full-catalogue CCOpt qualification is not established by this Ipopt evidence.

slices.meaning: Scenario addition and exhaustive final audit

records.title: Extended model scope
records.meaning: Add multi-period, data-adapter and mixed-control capabilities as qualified slices.
records.status: Selected slices implemented; broader extensions open
records.scope: Deterministic period dispatch/shared curves and ramps, RAW import/saved-state checks, mixed AVR/droop and declared capability circles.
records.method: Qualify each extension under its own input, information, capability and replay contract; retain native RAW export gaps and unverified equipment assumptions.

findings.result: Five hourly 3/14/500-bus comparisons; 30 base-operation states independently replayed; fixed equipment.
Strict AC conversion for supported v33/v34/v36 schemas; native v36 export qualification pending.

Replay VM/VA/PG/QG without optimization or state repair; default saved-export tolerance 0.01 MW/MVAr per bus, distinct from solver acceptance. Missing ratings remain thermally unassessed; an import placeholder is not an equipment rating.
Later outage recourse and AVR schedules have campaign-specific evidence under P2.
Storage, detailed GFL/GFM, dynamics and general discrete equipment scheduling.

records.boundary: The initial base-operation profiles do not establish N−1 or transient security. Apparent ratings and ramp rates are explicit study assumptions.
